purpose: Specialize the existing immutable decision-state + population-receipt + membership-overlay architecture for promotion-grade A/B setup scarcity evidence without creating a second storage model.
invariants: Formal gate order, A/B thresholds, B-over-A precedence, ranking, quota, capital, monitor, signal and push behavior unchanged.
Parent receipt is selection-time and outcome-free.
UNKNOWN/NOT_EVALUABLE never become PASS/FAIL or zero margins.
Semantic membership is complete before bounded sample membership.
Historical mutable Shadow rows are not rewritten.
All outcome joins reference the exact immutable parent key/generation.

exactFormalProvenance: A bitmask and exact six check booleans
B bitmask and exact six check booleans

A: pullback lower and upper band margins
volume OR-branch margins and effective Formal truthiness values
structure close/support and low/prior-low margins with conditional-redundancy flag
B: candle-close geometry: strongClose and upperShadow raw values/margins retained together

interpretationGuards: Exact masks are provenance, not six independent dimensions.
B strongClose pass structurally implies upperShadow pass under coherent OHLC; do not double-weight.
A support close-clause is structurally clear on FILTERED_CANDIDATE mode but can bind on MA20_FALLBACK.
A volume and B trend are composite OR logic; never average branch margins into one unregistered distance.
No normalized composite setup distance is authorized.

requiredCounts: pool x nearestChannel x exactCheckPattern populationCount
populationReceipt.cleanRule: CLEAN only if complete same-generation parent coverage is positively proven, duplicateParentKeyCount=0, invalidStratumCount=0 and expected/persisted counts reconcile.
populationReceipt.zeroCellRule: A missing setup stratum is an explicit zero only for a CLEAN complete frame; otherwise UNKNOWN.

membershipOverlay.sampleMembership: Separate deterministic bounded overlay only for SETUP_FIRST_FAILURE strata.
membershipOverlay.stratum: scanDate x pool x nearestChannel x exactCheckPattern
membershipOverlay.rule: Changing sample cap must not change semantic population counts or parent setup state.

inferenceGuards: No outcome join before parent frame is CLEAN.
No complete-case coercion: missing outcome coverage stays UNKNOWN.
No threshold sweep or fitted distance weights before preregistered baseline evidence.
Date is the independent clustering unit for market-wide shared shocks.
Report check identity and raw margin incremental value separately before any threshold discussion.

acceptanceTests: No-decision-diff: selected symbols/order/plans/capital/signals/push byte-equivalent with observer capture on/off.
All SETUP_FIRST_FAILURE rows have every earlier gate positively clear in the same parent generation.
PRE_SETUP_NOT_REACHED raw geometry never enters setup-first-failure denominator.
B dual-pass rows retain B precedence.
Exact observer pass booleans agree with Formal AB_SETUP state or quality becomes UNKNOWN.
Population counts are computed before bounded samples.
Sample-cap changes cannot alter semantic counts.
B strongClose=true and upperShadow=false is rejected as provenance inconsistency for coherent OHLC-derived fields.
Filtered support mode marks close>=0.985*support as structurally non-independent; MA20 fallback does not.
Duplicate parent identity with divergent fingerprint is PROVENANCE_CONFLICT, never overwrite.
Reader pagination/keyset proves full requested date coverage before promotion-grade inference.
